briefdescription.para: Maximum clock parent-chain depth for iterative rate calculation.

detaileddescription.para: Limits traversal in XPmClock_CalculateRate() to guard against runaway walks on malformed or unexpectedly deep topologies.

briefdescription.para: SoC-critical clocks that must remain enabled even when no device owns them.
Check whether a clock is on the SoC-critical clock list.

simplesect.para: 1 if the clock is SoC-critical, 0 otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Request a clock and maintain its use count.

detaileddescription.para: On the first request, initialize the parent selection if needed, request the parent clock or PLL, mark the clock as requested, and attempt to enable its gate. Increment the use count when execution reaches the count update, unless the count is already at its maximum.

parameterdescription.para: Clock node to request. A NULL pointer is ignored.

inbodydescription.para: CCF should not disable unused clocks since all clocks are managed by PLM and when XPm_InitFinalize() is called PLM will release all unused devices and disables its clocks. So add CLK_IGNORE_UNUSED flag for all GATE to avoid disabling unused clocks from Linux CCF driver.

briefdescription.para: Compute one clock node's rate from its parent rate.

detaileddescription.para: Reference clocks inherit ParentRate. PLL nodes read FBDIV and multiply the parent rate. Output clocks read DIV1 topology and register data, then apply the configured linear or power-of-two divider. No clock state is changed.

parameterdescription.para: Clock node whose rate is computed.

simplesect.para: Computed rate in Hz. Returns ParentRate for reference clocks, unrecognized clock types, output clocks without DIV1, and output clocks whose zero divider is allowed. Returns 0 for invalid input, a failed parameter read, or a zero divider that is not allowed.

briefdescription.para: Iteratively calculate the clock rate for a given clock node.

detaileddescription.para: Walks up the parent chain collecting unresolved nodes, then walks back down computing and caching rates. Bounded by MAX_CLK_CHAIN_DEPTH to prevent runaway traversal on malformed topologies.

simplesect.para: Calculated clock rate in Hz, or 0 on failure

briefdescription.para: Get the cached clock rate for a given clock node.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to store the clock rate in Hz
